summary: Arion banki hf. provides various financial services to individuals, corporates, and investors in Iceland and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Markets and Stefnir. The Retail Banking segment offers financial services, which include deposits and loans, savings, payment cards, pensions, insurance, securities, and funds. Its Corporate & Investment Banking segment provides a range of products, such as guarantees, deposit accounts, payment solutions, and value-added digital solutions to SMEs, large-cap companies, and investors; and various financial advisory services, including M&A advisory, private placements, IPOs, and other offerings of securities. The Markets and Stefnir segment manages financial assets on behalf of its customers, as well as a range of mutual, investment, and institutional investor funds; operates and develops pension funds; and provides various services for capital markets and securities brokerage services. It is also involved in insurance and real estate business; and offers asset management and rental guarantee services. Arion banki hf. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Reykjavík, Iceland.
